name: prompt-polish
description: Polishes your prompt for the model before you send it, and shows it next to the original

polishModel.title: Polish Model
polishModel.description: The model that polishes your prompt. A short name like sonnet, or a full model name.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How hard the model thinks while polishing. Higher is more careful but slower.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: Where the Claude desktop app shows Prompt Polish: a band above the prompt box (band), or a pane beside the conversation (pane). The terminal and other apps always use the pane.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Opens the Prompt Polish pane when a session starts.
